note: Which risk area's assessor may attest an answer about a control family (FR-17), and what to call that family on a screen. Versioned because it decides ACCOUNTABILITY — who is answerable for signing off what — and that is an owner decision, not a rendering choice. A family with no mapping falls to the generalist rather than to nobody. `name` and `order` were added for the control register (G-87): the codes are internal and may never reach a screen (NFR-9), and alphabetical order would put the rarest family above identity on every assessment.
